collection.title: Cupra (SEAT) Formentor 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Cupra Formentor 2020 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Formentor which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
